name: Paneer Butter Masala
description: Creamy paneer curry with tomato and butter.
instructions: Cook onion and tomato with spices. Blend into a smooth gravy. Add paneer, butter and cream. Simmer until cooked.

name: Palak Paneer
description: Paneer cooked in a creamy spinach gravy.
instructions: Blanch spinach and blend. Cook onion, tomato and spices. Add spinach and paneer. Simmer with cream.

name: Kadai Paneer
description: Spicy paneer cooked with capsicum and tomato.
instructions: Saute onion, capsicum and tomato with spices. Add paneer and kadai masala. Cook until tender.

name: Shahi Paneer
description: Rich paneer curry with a mildly sweet gravy.
instructions: Cook onion, tomato, cashews and spices. Blend smoothly. Add paneer and cream and simmer.

name: Matar Paneer
description: Paneer and peas cooked in tomato gravy.
instructions: Cook onion and tomato with spices. Add peas and cook until tender. Add paneer and simmer.

name: Chana Masala
description: Spicy chickpea curry with tomato and onion.
instructions: Cook onion, tomato and spices. Add boiled chickpeas and water. Simmer until the gravy thickens.

name: Rajma Masala
description: Kidney beans cooked in a spiced tomato gravy.
instructions: Cook onion, tomato and spices. Add boiled kidney beans and water. Simmer until thick.

name: Dal Tadka
description: Yellow lentils finished with a fragrant tempering.
instructions: Cook lentils until soft. Fry cumin, garlic, onion and spices in oil. Pour the tempering over dal.

name: Dal Makhani
description: Creamy black lentils slow-cooked with spices.
instructions: Cook soaked black lentils until soft. Add tomato, butter and spices. Simmer and finish with cream.

name: Aloo Gobi
description: Potatoes and cauliflower cooked with Indian spices.
instructions: Saute cumin, onion and spices. Add potato and cauliflower. Cover and cook until tender.

name: Aloo Jeera
description: Simple cumin-flavored potato fry.
instructions: Heat oil with cumin. Add potatoes, turmeric and spices. Fry until golden and cooked.

name: Bhindi Masala
description: Okra cooked with onion and tomato.
instructions: Fry sliced okra until lightly crisp. Cook onion and tomato with spices. Combine and cook briefly.

name: Baingan Bharta
description: Roasted eggplant mashed with onion and tomato.
instructions: Roast eggplant until soft. Peel and mash it. Cook with onion, tomato and spices.

name: Mixed Vegetable Curry
description: Mixed vegetables cooked in a spiced gravy.
instructions: Saute onion and tomato with spices. Add mixed vegetables and water. Cover and cook until tender.

name: Vegetable Korma
description: Mixed vegetables in a creamy nut-based gravy.
instructions: Cook vegetables until tender. Blend cashews with spices. Combine with vegetables and cream.

name: Malai Kofta
description: Vegetable and paneer dumplings in creamy gravy.
instructions: Make paneer-potato balls and fry. Prepare a tomato-cashew gravy. Add koftas before serving.

name: Mushroom Masala
description: Mushrooms cooked with onion and tomato spices.
instructions: Saute mushrooms. Cook onion, tomato and spices separately. Combine and simmer.

name: Matar Mushroom
description: Mushrooms and green peas in tomato gravy.
instructions: Cook onion and tomato with spices. Add mushrooms and peas. Simmer until tender.

name: Corn Palak
description: Sweet corn cooked in spinach gravy.
instructions: Blanch and blend spinach. Cook onion and spices. Add corn and spinach puree and simmer.

name: Karela Fry
description: Crispy bitter gourd slices with spices.
instructions: Slice and salt bitter gourd. Fry with onion and spices until crisp.

name: Cabbage Poriyal
description: South Indian cabbage stir-fry with coconut.
instructions: Saute mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add cabbage and turmeric. Cook and finish with coconut.

name: Beans Poriyal
description: Green beans tempered with mustard and coconut.
instructions: Saute mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add beans and turmeric. Cook until tender and add coconut.

name: Carrot Poriyal
description: Carrots stir-fried with coconut and spices.
instructions: Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves. Add chopped carrots and turmeric. Cook until tender and add coconut.

name: Avial
description: Mixed vegetables cooked with coconut and yogurt.
instructions: Cook mixed vegetables with turmeric. Grind coconut and green chili. Mix with yogurt and simmer gently.

name: Vegetable Sambar
description: Lentil and vegetable stew with tamarind.
instructions: Cook dal and vegetables. Add sambar powder and tamarind. Simmer and temper with mustard and curry leaves.

name: Rasam
description: Tangy South Indian soup with tomato and spices.
instructions: Cook tomato with tamarind and spices. Add rasam powder and water. Simmer and temper with mustard and curry leaves.

name: Lemon Rice
description: Rice tossed with lemon, peanuts and tempering.
instructions: Cook rice and cool slightly. Temper mustard, peanuts, curry leaves and chili. Add rice and lemon juice.

name: Tamarind Rice
description: Tangy rice mixed with tamarind and spices.
instructions: Prepare tamarind spice paste. Mix with cooked rice and tempering. Rest briefly before serving.

name: Curd Rice
description: Cooling rice mixed with yogurt and tempering.
instructions: Mix cooked rice with yogurt and salt. Temper mustard, curry leaves and chili. Stir into rice.

name: Pongal
description: Soft rice and lentils cooked with pepper and cumin.
instructions: Cook rice and moong dal until soft. Temper cumin, pepper, ginger and curry leaves. Mix together.

name: Ven Pongal
description: Savory South Indian rice and lentil dish.
instructions: Cook rice and dal until creamy. Temper cumin, pepper, ginger and curry leaves. Combine.

name: Upma
description: Savory semolina breakfast with vegetables.
instructions: Roast semolina. Temper mustard, curry leaves and onion. Add water and semolina and cook until fluffy.

name: Poha
description: Flattened rice cooked with onion, peanuts and lemon.
instructions: Rinse poha. Temper mustard, peanuts and onion. Add poha, turmeric and lemon juice and cook briefly.

name: Masala Dosa
description: Crispy dosa filled with spiced potato.
instructions: Prepare dosa batter and cook thin on a hot pan. Fill with potato masala and fold.

name: Idli
description: Soft steamed rice and lentil cakes.
instructions: Prepare fermented rice and urad dal batter. Pour into idli molds and steam until cooked.

name: Medu Vada
description: Crispy lentil fritters with herbs and spices.
instructions: Grind soaked urad dal into a thick batter. Shape into rings and deep fry until golden.

name: Vegetable Biryani
description: Fragrant basmati rice cooked with mixed vegetables and spices.
instructions: Cook vegetables with whole spices. Layer with partially cooked rice. Cover and cook until fragrant.

name: Paneer Biryani
description: Basmati rice layered with spiced paneer.
instructions: Marinate paneer with yogurt and spices. Cook rice partly. Layer paneer and rice and finish on low heat.

name: Jeera Rice
description: Basmati rice flavored with cumin and ghee.
instructions: Temper cumin in ghee. Add cooked basmati rice and salt. Toss gently and serve.

name: Pulao
description: Fragrant rice cooked with vegetables and whole spices.
instructions: Fry whole spices and onion. Add vegetables and rice with water. Cook until rice is fluffy.

name: Veg Fried Rice
description: Indo-Chinese rice stir-fried with vegetables.
instructions: Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat. Add cooked rice and sauces. Toss until hot.

name: Gobi Manchurian
description: Crispy cauliflower tossed in spicy sauce.
instructions: Coat cauliflower and fry until crisp. Stir-fry garlic, onion and sauces. Toss cauliflower in the sauce.

name: Paneer Tikka
description: Spiced paneer and vegetables grilled until charred.
instructions: Marinate paneer and vegetables in yogurt and spices. Skewer and grill until lightly charred.

name: Aloo Tikki
description: Crispy potato patties with Indian spices.
instructions: Mash boiled potatoes with spices and herbs. Shape into patties and shallow fry until crisp.

name: Pav Bhaji
description: Spiced mashed vegetables served with toasted pav.
instructions: Cook potatoes and mixed vegetables. Mash with bhaji masala and butter. Toast pav and serve.

name: Chole Bhature
description: Spicy chickpeas served with fried bhature.
instructions: Cook chickpeas in onion-tomato gravy with spices. Prepare dough and fry bhature until puffed.

name: Palak Corn
description: Corn cooked in creamy spinach gravy.
instructions: Blend blanched spinach. Cook onion and spices. Add corn and spinach and simmer with cream.

name: Methi Malai Matar
description: Fenugreek leaves and peas in creamy gravy.
instructions: Cook onion and cashews and blend. Add peas and fenugreek leaves. Finish with cream and spices.

name: Stuffed Capsicum
description: Capsicums stuffed with spiced potato and paneer.
instructions: Prepare potato-paneer filling. Stuff capsicums and bake or cook covered until tender.

name: Dum Aloo
description: Baby potatoes cooked in a rich spiced gravy.
instructions: Fry or roast baby potatoes. Prepare yogurt-tomato gravy with spices. Add potatoes and simmer.

name: Chicken Curry
description: Classic Indian chicken curry with onion and tomato.
instructions: Brown chicken with spices. Cook onion, tomato, ginger and garlic. Add chicken and simmer until cooked.

name: Butter Chicken
description: Tender chicken in a creamy tomato-butter gravy.
instructions: Cook marinated chicken. Prepare tomato gravy with butter and cream. Add chicken and simmer.

name: Chicken Tikka Masala
description: Grilled chicken pieces in spiced tomato gravy.
instructions: Marinate and grill chicken. Cook onion and tomato with spices. Add grilled chicken and cream.

name: Kadai Chicken
description: Spicy chicken cooked with capsicum and kadai spices.
instructions: Cook chicken with onion and spices. Add tomato and capsicum. Simmer until chicken is tender.

name: Chicken Biryani
description: Fragrant rice layered with spiced chicken.
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices. Partially cook rice. Layer chicken and rice and cook on low heat.

name: Chicken Pulao
description: One-pot spiced rice with tender chicken.
instructions: Brown chicken with onion and spices. Add rice and water. Cover and cook until rice is fluffy.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
description: Indo-Chinese fried rice with chicken and vegetables.
instructions: Stir-fry chicken and vegetables. Add cooked rice and sauces. Toss on high heat.

name: Chicken 65
description: Crispy spicy fried chicken bites.
instructions: Marinate chicken with yogurt, spices and flour. Deep fry until crisp and toss with curry leaves.

name: Chicken Chettinad
description: Spicy South Indian chicken with roasted spices.
instructions: Roast spices and coconut and grind. Cook onion and tomato. Add chicken and spice paste and simmer.

name: Chicken Korma
description: Mild chicken curry with yogurt and nuts.
instructions: Cook chicken with onion and spices. Add cashew paste and yogurt. Simmer until creamy.

name: Andhra Chicken Curry
description: Fiery chicken curry with South Indian spices.
instructions: Cook onion, green chili and spices. Add chicken and tomato. Simmer until tender.

name: Kerala Chicken Curry
description: Coconut-based chicken curry with curry leaves.
instructions: Cook onion, ginger, garlic and spices. Add chicken and coconut milk. Simmer until cooked.

name: Chicken Saag
description: Chicken cooked in spiced spinach gravy.
instructions: Cook chicken with spices. Add blended spinach and simmer. Finish with cream if desired.

name: Chicken Do Pyaza
description: Chicken cooked with plenty of onion.
instructions: Brown chicken with spices. Cook sliced onion and tomato. Add chicken and simmer until tender.

name: Tandoori Chicken
description: Yogurt-marinated chicken roasted with spices.
instructions: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon and spices. Roast or grill until cooked and lightly charred.

name: Chicken Seekh Kebab
description: Spiced minced chicken kebabs grilled on skewers.
instructions: Mix minced chicken with onion, herbs and spices. Shape around skewers and grill until cooked.

name: Mutton Rogan Josh
description: Slow-cooked mutton in a Kashmiri-style gravy.
instructions: Brown mutton with spices. Add yogurt and aromatics. Cover and slow-cook until tender.

name: Mutton Curry
description: Spiced mutton curry with onion and tomato.
instructions: Brown mutton. Cook onion, tomato and spices. Add water and slow-cook until tender.

name: Mutton Biryani
description: Layered basmati rice and spiced mutton.
instructions: Marinate and cook mutton until tender. Partially cook rice. Layer and finish on low heat.

name: Mutton Keema
description: Minced mutton cooked with peas and spices.
instructions: Brown minced mutton. Add onion, tomato and spices. Add peas and cook until done.

name: Mutton Korma
description: Rich mutton curry with yogurt and nuts.
instructions: Brown mutton with spices. Add yogurt and cashew paste. Slow-cook until tender.

name: Mutton Sukka
description: Dry South Indian-style spiced mutton.
instructions: Cook mutton until tender. Roast coconut and spices. Toss cooked mutton with the spice mixture.

name: Pepper Mutton
description: Spicy mutton cooked with black pepper.
instructions: Cook mutton with onion, ginger and garlic. Add crushed black pepper and simmer until tender.

name: Mutton Chettinad
description: Mutton cooked with roasted Chettinad spices and coconut.
instructions: Roast spices and coconut and grind. Cook mutton with onion and tomato. Add spice paste and slow-cook.

name: Fish Curry
description: Fish cooked in a tangy spiced gravy.
instructions: Cook onion, tomato and spices. Add tamarind and water. Gently simmer fish until cooked.

name: Kerala Fish Curry
description: Fish cooked with coconut and tamarind.
instructions: Cook spices and aromatics. Add coconut milk and tamarind. Gently simmer fish until cooked.

name: Goan Fish Curry
description: Tangy coconut fish curry with chili.
instructions: Blend coconut, chili and spices. Cook with tamarind and onion. Add fish and simmer gently.

name: Fish Fry
description: Crispy shallow-fried fish marinated with spices.
instructions: Marinate fish with lemon and spices. Coat lightly with semolina if desired. Shallow fry until crisp.

name: Prawn Masala
description: Prawns cooked in spicy onion-tomato masala.
instructions: Saute onion, tomato and spices. Add prawns and cook briefly until just done.

name: Prawn Curry
description: Prawns simmered in coconut-spiced gravy.
instructions: Cook onion and spices. Add coconut milk and tamarind. Add prawns and simmer briefly.

name: Egg Curry
description: Boiled eggs cooked in spiced tomato gravy.
instructions: Boil and peel eggs. Cook onion and tomato with spices. Add eggs and simmer in gravy.

name: Masala Omelette
description: Indian omelette with onion, tomato and green chili.
instructions: Beat eggs with chopped onion, tomato and chili. Season and cook on both sides.

name: Egg Bhurji
description: Scrambled eggs cooked with onion and tomato.
instructions: Saute onion, tomato and chili. Add beaten eggs and scramble until just cooked.

name: Egg Biryani
description: Spiced basmati rice layered with boiled eggs.
instructions: Cook spiced rice. Boil eggs and lightly fry them. Layer eggs with rice and cook briefly.

name: Egg Masala
description: Eggs coated in a spicy onion-tomato masala.
instructions: Boil eggs and fry lightly. Cook onion, tomato and spices. Toss eggs in the masala.
